action.label: query
action.description: Action to perform such as start,stop,enable,disable on one or more processors

filter.label: query
filter.description: Filters the processors matching by processor id, route id, or route group, and source location

limit.label: query
limit.description: Limits the number of entries displayed

nodePrefixId.description: The node prefix ID (only present when known)

description.description: The processor description (only present when configured)

note.description: The processor note (only present when configured)

source.description: The source location, optionally with a line number suffix (only present when known)

disabled.description: Whether the processor is disabled (only present when known)

stepId.description: The step ID (only present when known)

line.description: The source line number (only present when known)

match.description: Whether this is the matched line (only present when true)

code.description: A snippet of source code around the processor (only present when known)

level.description: The processor level in the route tree

uri.description: The destination URI, for processors that send to a destination (only present when applicable)

idleSince.description: Epoch time in milliseconds since the processor has been idle

exchangesThroughput.description: Messages per second throughput (only present when available)

p50ProcessingTime.description: 50th percentile processing time in milliseconds (only present when available)

p95ProcessingTime.description: 95th percentile processing time in milliseconds (only present when available)

p99ProcessingTime.description: 99th percentile processing time in milliseconds (only present when available)

lastProcessingTime.description: Processing time in milliseconds of the last exchange (only present once an exchange has completed)

deltaProcessingTime.description: Difference in processing time in milliseconds since the previous exchange (only present once an exchange has completed)

lastCreatedExchangeTimestamp.description: Epoch time in milliseconds the last exchange was created (only present once an exchange has been created)

lastCompletedExchangeTimestamp.description: Epoch time in milliseconds the last exchange completed (only present once an exchange has completed)

lastFailureHandledExchangeTimestamp.description: Epoch time in milliseconds the last exchange failure was handled (only present once one has occurred)

lastFailedExchangeTimestamp.description: Epoch time in milliseconds the last exchange failed (only present once one has occurred)

processors.description: The processors (only present when no action was requested)
